1. (Currently amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) is the only bovine viral diarrhea virus in the composition,__ a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.

3. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), [[a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or]] an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.

4. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, [[a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or]] a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.

6. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein the at least a first antigen is not a Leptospira antigen.__

7. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, [[Leptospira,]] Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

8. (Currently amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated.

12. (Currently amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of [[a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen]] __at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen, wherein the microbial pathogen-specific antigen is not a Leptospira antigen.__
